tutortrace.label: Inspect one student’s session
tutortrace.description: Inspect one real TutorTrace session chosen by Bart and follow its coding events in time order.
tutortrace.why: See what the data looks like before deciding what might signal struggle.

tutortrace.label: Highlight one struggle signal
tutortrace.description: Apply one simple default struggle rule to that same session and mark the moments where it fires.
tutortrace.why: See what one definition of struggle picks out before trying to refine it.

tutortrace.label: Adjust the struggle rule
tutortrace.description: Change one time threshold on that same session and check which moments become highlighted or disappear.
tutortrace.why: Start judging what counts as struggle by seeing the effect of one change.

scientific-dataset.label: Inspect one microscope image
scientific-dataset.description: Inspect one real microscope image chosen by Bart and locate a single cell to examine more closely.
scientific-dataset.why: Start with a visible example before deciding how to measure a cell.

scientific-dataset.label: Measure the cell’s area
scientific-dataset.description: Apply a default brightness threshold to outline that cell in the same image and measure its area in pixels.
scientific-dataset.why: See what a threshold includes before trying to improve the measurement.

scientific-dataset.label: Adjust the brightness threshold
scientific-dataset.description: Change the brightness threshold for that same cell and compare its new outline and area with the original result.
scientific-dataset.why: Judge how one choice affects the measurement on an example you already know.

software-project.label: Run the editor’s sample note
software-project.description: Open the existing editor with its bundled sample note, ready to inspect the text without setting up the project yourself.
software-project.why: Start with something running before working out how its formatting should behave.

software-project.label: Render the sample as Markdown
software-project.description: Render that same sample note as Markdown and check how its heading appears in the formatted result.
software-project.why: See one formatting case work before experimenting with the rules behind it.

software-project.label: Test a different heading level
software-project.description: Change the heading level in that same note and check how its appearance changes in the formatted result.
software-project.why: Connect one edit to its effect before trying other formatting behaviors.
